userStories.title: [Regression Test] CLI: spiral trace-dependencies <story-id> - Federated Cross-Project Dependency Res
userStories.description: Write regression test to guard against future breakage of US-675. Story description: New CLI command that recursively resolves and visualizes a story's full dependency chain across federated sub-projects. Detects circular dependencies, displays file paths, and marks sub-project boundaries. Critical for multi-project workflows where US-001 in project-a may depend on PROJECT-B-US-005.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression test covers core observable behaviour of US-675
Test would reliably fail if the US-675 feature were removed or broken
technicalNotes: Run: uv run pytest tests/ -k us_675 -v

userStories.title: Add e2e integration test: full SPIRAL loop with mocked Claude CLI
